{{Quote|Prepared to meet your terms are we&hellip; For ''one'' Galactic credit!''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''One credit?''<nowiki></nowiki>''"<br />"''And the promise that, as long as the Sheena Run ''[sic]'' is kept free from Separatist ships&hellip; the Senate will not investigate your&hellip; ''other'' criminal activities.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Tagta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]|<ref name="TGoNH" />}}
The '''Sheela Run''' was a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] running through the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], in the vicinity of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Hekka]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] used the Sheela Run to transfer matériel throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TGoNH" />

The Sheela Run shared its name with the [[Sheela system/Legends|Sheela system]],<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Sheela Run|system=[[Sheela system/Legends|Sheela system]]|legends=1}}</ref> a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
